# Community intake governance

The organization default repository owns shared conduct, support and security
routing, moderation principles, and the common `source/*`, `state/*`, `kind/*`,
and `impact/*` taxonomy.

Each project repository owns its Issue Forms, technical routing, maintainer
responsibilities, and any `area/*` or `platform/*` extensions. Product,
standards, build, and image repositories keep independent technical authority
and queues.

Humans decide security disposition, moderation, priority, closure, support
commitments, and roadmap outcomes. Automation may provide deterministic
acknowledgement, sanitization guidance, structured summaries, reproduction
extraction, duplicate candidates, and Known Issues links. Public text, links,
attachments, diagnostics, and commands are untrusted data and are never
executed.
